universal_guidelines: NEVER use default Tailwind colors (blue-500, etc.). Use semantic names (primary, secondary).
Headings must be Serif (Fraunces). Body must be Sans (DM Sans).
Spacing is luxury. Use p-8+ for major containers.
No gradients on text unless it's a very large heading.
Interactive elements must have a :hover state that changes transform (translate-y) or shadow, not just color.
All functional elements must have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables in :root.
Install the required fonts via Google Fonts in index.css.
Configure tailwind.config.js to use the 'Fraunces' and 'DM Sans' font families.
Use the provided image URLs for the landing page and demo data.
Implement the 'Bento' grid layout for the course listing on the home page.
Ensure the Dashboard uses the 'Dense' grid layout for data visualization.
For the Video Player, use a 'Cinema Mode' layout (dark background, focused content) even if the rest of the app is light.
Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect (border gradient) for the 'Featured Course' card.
